name: U-Pick Blueberry Patch
description: In Lanoka Harbor, NJ, U-Pick Blueberry Patch grows Blueberries on a working u-pick farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. The season runs through summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
